leadZh: 以《茶金》、《牽紙鷂的手》兩度榮獲金鐘獎剪輯獎，並以《我們與惡的距離II》《有生之年》入圍金鐘獎戲劇類剪輯獎。
leadEn: A two-time winner of the Golden Bell Award for Best Editing for a Drama Series for “Gold Leaf” and “The Kite Soaring,” with additional nominations in the same category for “The World Between Us: After the Flames” and “Living.”
subZh: 近期作品包括《祭弒》、《那張照片裡的我們》、《我們與惡的距離 II》、《拜六禮拜》、《人浮於愛》、《夏日最後的祕密》等。現成立「原本那間剪輯工作室」。
subEn: Recent works include “The Tao Exorcist,” “The Photo from 1977,” “The World Between Us: After the Flames,” “Holiday,” “Adrift in Love,” and “Summer Blue Hour.” He is also the founder of LTH FILM STUDIO.
